description: Nameserver (glue) record from RDAP — the registry's record for a host like "ns1.example.com", with its IP addresses and status. Answers "what are the IPs behind this nameserver" and "is this nameserver registered".

base.description: Optional registry RDAP base URL. Skips IANA bootstrap lookup — use it when a TLD comes back as tld_not_in_iana_bootstrap.

name: nameserver
